answer: Reputation Leadger with Operator Drag: each agent identity is issued against a registered operator and carries a persistent reputation score. A cluster of synthetic identities behaving in lockstep flags the operator, who then loses access to a shared resource pool — a garden of pre-approved compute and routing quotas — for a cooldown period. Detection uses behavioral clustering plus a slow shale-like layering of trust: new operators start on a small island of limited throughput.
